items.title: Did prediction markets call the U.S. midterm election?: State of Crypto
items.summary: Prediction markets and polls largely aligned by the end of the 2026 election cycle, and both had notable misses.

items.title: Crypto insiders aren't counting on silver linings in Congress' 'lame duck' session
items.summary: With ascendent Democrats ready to pursue their own crypto and tech agendas next year, the final weeks of this session probably won't produce crypto surprises.

items.title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
items.summary: XRP tanked to its lowest level since November 2024 as ETF outflows and shrinking stablecoin supply add to pressure on crypto markets.

items.title: Bitcoin crashes to 3-month low below $63,000 as analyst flags fourth capitulation wave
items.summary: "They are now selling at the very price they wish they had taken advantage of three months ago," wrote James Check.

items.title: Ethereum scaling project MegaETH slashes staff by 20% as it pursues AI business
items.summary: Decentralized Finance total value locked on MegaETH dropped significantly from over $245 million to $8.8 million.

items.title: Kazakhstan plans tokenized government bonds in first quarter after $22 million note sale
items.summary: The plan follows Kazakhstan's first sale of tokenized central bank notes as the country expands its crypto market.

items.title: UK, Singapore, and Thailand central banks test cross-border FX settlement as stablecoins gain ground
items.summary: Project Meridian FX APAC said it demonstrated how transactions can be coordinated across conventional settlement systems and those built using blockchain technology.

items.title: Britain could turn wasted Scottish wind power into bitcoin to cut its $1.3 billion grid bill
items.summary: Britain could use bitcoin mining to absorb surplus Scottish wind power and reduce payments to wind farms to halt generation, according to a Bitcoin Policy Institute report.

items.title: A behind the scenes force may amplify bitcoin and ether price volatility
items.summary: Both bitcoin and ether are trading in price ranges where market makers and dealers may add to market volatility.

items.title: Satoshi-era wallet served in a $260 billion lawsuit moves 75 BTC it held since 2011
items.summary: The roughly $5 million transfer also spent the tiny payment used to deliver a court notice to the address in May.

items.title: US sellers drive Bitcoin crash, Jensen plots comeback: Hodler’s Digest
items.summary: Anchorage Digital data suggests the Bitcoin selloff is being driven by US investors. A “war room” has been set up by supporters to reinstate NVIDIA boss Jensen Huang.

items.title: Enterprise blockchain is going to come back from the dead
items.summary: With scalability, privacy tools and onchain liquidity improving, businesses may finally have the infrastructure to make enterprise blockchain work.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Bitcoin falls to four-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
items.summary: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 4% to $2.26 trillion over 24 hours, while Ether and Solana posted double-digit weekly losses.

items.title: Coinone warns of phishing, identity theft after customer data breach
items.summary: The South Korean crypto exchange said potentially exposed information includes passwords, bank account numbers, national identification numbers and crypto wallet addresses.

items.title: RWA protocol stUSDT winds down three years after $2.3B TVL peak
items.summary: The stUSDT team did not disclose a reason for winding down the RWA protocol but assured holders that all underlying assets remain fully backed.

items.title: Microsoft confirms global outage resolved, rules out cyberattack
items.summary: Microsoft attributed the outage to a network capacity upgrade issue, confirming that the disruption was unrelated to cyberattacks or AI agents.

items.title: MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push
items.summary: MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the restructuring affected employees who helped build the project’s blockchain, wallet and ecosystem.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in 2 weeks, BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $185.4 million in net outflows Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million and Fidelity’s FBTC shedding $41.9 million.

items.title: OpenAI launches AI payments in ChatGPT with Visa, Mastercard and Amex
items.summary: OpenAI’s new payment wallet lets AI agents complete purchases using existing card networks, with plans to eventually allow preauthorized transactions.

items.title: How Wall Street Is Racing to Claim the Onchain Dollar
items.summary: From Goldman and Citi’s $270 million “Project Faro” to SoFi, Anchorage, Mastercard, Visa and Circle, traditional finance is racing to claim the onchain dollar once dominated by Tether and Circle.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Lose $2.1 Billion in November as Outflow Streak Hits Seven Days
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $185.4 million on Friday, their seventh straight day of outflows, pushing November losses to about $2.1 billion as Bitcoin fell toward $64,000.

items.title: The Week Jensen Huang Fell: How a Spy Scandal Toppled Nvidia’s CEO
items.summary: In a matter of days, the executive synonymous with the AI boom resigned after 33 years amid reports of affairs and suspected Chinese intelligence ties—sending Nvidia’s stock reeling and leaving the chipmaker leaderless.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Other AI Giants Face Lawsuit Demanding Development Freeze
items.summary: Four nonprofit advocacy groups want a California court to stop major AI developers from building stronger models, alleging their technology could cause catastrophic harm worldwide.

items.title: What Is Canton Network? The Privacy Blockchain Built for Wall Street
items.summary: Canton Network is a privacy-enabled blockchain built for banks and tokenized assets. Here's how it works and what Canton Coin (CC) does.

items.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet to Let AI Agents Shop—Without Crypto
items.summary: OpenAI’s new wallet lets AI agents buy products using ordinary cards, challenging crypto payment tools from Coinbase and Circle as companies compete to control everyday online shopping by autonomous software.

items.title: Could a Former Nvidia Executive Replace Jensen Huang? Arm’s Rene Haas Emerges as Candidate
items.summary: Nvidia's board has reportedly approached Arm's chief executive as it searches for a replacement for Jensen Huang, while some employees are pushing to bring the chipmaker's founder back as CEO.

items.title: Should Government Officials Be Banned From Prediction Markets? House Oversight Says Maybe
items.summary: A House Oversight staff memorandum, citing suspicious trades by officials, military personnel and clearance holders, recommends Congress weigh new limits on federal personnel betting on platforms like Kalshi and Polymark

items.title: China’s $3.2 Billion AI Pipeline Still Calls for Nvidia Chips Washington Restricts
items.summary: Chinese data center projects are still being designed around restricted Nvidia processors, even as Beijing pushes domestic alternatives.

items.title: JPMorgan’s Bitcoin and Crypto-Linked Holdings Approach $1 Billion
items.summary: The bank’s Q3 13F shows roughly $981 million across Bitcoin ETFs, Strategy and Coinbase—likely over $1 billion counting Robinhood and miners.
